text:
Ana (People Ops): Quick company update: launching a PTO Donation Pool and an Emergency Leave Top-up pilot. Also a short Travel Safety QuickForm for higher-risk regions. Links and TL;DR below.

Omar (People Ops): TL;DR: PTO Donation Pool allows employees to donate up to 40 hours/year into a shared pool used for colleagues facing unexpected caregiving/medical needs. Emergency Leave Top-up: up to 2 weeks (80 hours) of paid top-up for eligible cases, drawn from the pool; manager + People Ops approval required.

Claire (Payroll): Process note: donated hours are converted to a dollar balance using your base hourly rate at donation time and held centrally. When top-ups are granted we convert dollars back to hours at the recipients base rate and apply through payroll. Donors can specify anonymous or named donation on the form.

Ben (Eng): Is there a minimum donation, and can teams run internal matching?

Omar (People Ops): Minimum donation is 4 hours. Teams can run voluntary matching but it must be non-monetary org coordination (i.e., team budget match), People Ops will not automatically process matches.

Noor (Security): Travel Safety QuickForm is required for company-funded travel to any region flagged as "Risk: Elevated" by Security (we'll auto-flag bookings). The form collects emergency contacts, local embassy info, and a short risk acknowledgement. Security will review high-risk trips within 24 hours.

Ana (People Ops): Note on Code of Conduct: all in-person customer visits and sponsored fieldwork now require a short CoC acknowledgement to be completed at travel preapproval. Expense or travel reimbursements for company-funded customer visits will be held until acknowledgement is complete.

Ben (Eng): What counts as "customer visit" for this CoC requirement?

Omar (People Ops): Any scheduled in-person meeting at a customer office where Redwood is representing the company or delivering services. Internal team meetups and public conferences are not included unless the company is funding or organizing them.

Claire (Payroll): Eligibility for Emergency Leave Top-up: full-time employees with at least 6 months tenure; part-timers pro-rated. If the pool is exhausted, People Ops + Finance will evaluate emergency grants on a case-by-case basis.

Noor (Security): Travel Safety QuickForm link: https://forms.redwood/travel-safety-quickform. If Security flags a trip, you'll get a DM with mitigation steps and a go/no-go note. For urgent cases before approval, tag @security.

Ana (People Ops): Donation pool form + policy: https://forms.redwood/pto-donation-pool and https://docs.redwood/internal/pto-donation-policy. AMA tomorrow 4:00pm PT in #people-ops-ama to walk through examples (donor anonymity, payroll flow, travel flags).

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "PTO Donation AMA" tomorrow 4:00pm PT.

Ben (Eng): Thanks  appreciate the new safety form and the pool.

Ana (People Ops): Thanks all. If you want a private consult (sensitive situation), DM People Ops or reply here and we'll route to a confidential review.
